underrate.definition: v make too low an estimate of
underrate.translation: vt. 低估, 对...估计过低, 看轻

underrated.definition: v make too low an estimate of
underrated.translation: v. 对（某人或某事物）评价过低( underrate的过去式和过去分词 )

underrates.definition: v make too low an estimate of
underrates.translation: v. 对（某人或某事物）评价过低( underrate的第三人称单数 )

underrating.definition:
n an estimation that is too low; an estimate that is less than the true or actual value
v make too low an estimate of
underrating.translation: v. 对（某人或某事物）评价过低( underrate的现在分词 )

underreact.translation: vi.反应不够有力,未作出应有的反应

underreaction.translation: n. 不够有力的反应,不充分反应

underrefining.translation: 精炼不 足, 欠精炼

underreport.translation:
vt. 少报(收入), 低估
[经] 少报(收入等)低估

underrun.definition:
v. t. To run or pass under; especially (Naut.), to pass
   along and under, as a cable, for the purpose of taking it in, or of
   examining it.
underrun.translation:
vt. 在...下通过(或跑过), 用手拉起并顺序检查(电缆、软管等)
n. 在底下通过的东西(如流水等), 低于估计的产量
[计] 欠载运行
